selection: All archived candidates, without filtering by grade. Freeze candidate and prompt hashes before applying unchanged B2. Verify prompt bytes against the original experiment manifest.
decision: If there are changed candidates outside patch-development tasks, freeze them for a separate semantic paired evaluation before adoption. If none, independent natural benefit is unestablished: do not broaden the selector to force coverage, regenerate the known task, run a full generation batch, or adopt the patch.
reproducibility: Repeat every transform and apply it again for idempotence. Unchanged candidates must remain byte-identical. Source and prompt snapshots stay private. Failures are never silently skipped.
limits: This is an applicability audit, not functional grading or a new full-set score.
These are historically observed datasets; a new replay is not a previously unseen benchmark.
Variants of Prob115 remain the same known input, irrespective of source hash or mode.
RTLLM has documented contract defects; no assumption that all 44 tasks have valid functional oracles.
Only prompt and candidate bytes enter selector and patch. Reference, testbench and grades are not read by this stage.
